job.title: IT Support Associate II, Ops Tech Solutions (OTS)

details.about: Ops Tech Solutions (OTS) provides round-the-clock global IT support to Amazon Operations. As an IT Support Associate II, you help the operations team solve technical problems across a range of disciplines in Amazon operations facilities within a defined area, with encouragement to take part in career development opportunities.
duties: Allocate, maintain and troubleshoot IT equipment used in Amazon Operations facilities
Handle support requests and procedures across the network
Support customers in several buildings in the area, as well as remote customers
Travel within your local or regional area to support customers
needs: Experience troubleshooting integrated and interdependent computer systems
Experience in a dynamic, customer-service-focused environment
1+ years of Windows, Mac or Linux operating system support experience, or equivalent
Able to lift up to 49 lbs, stand and walk during shifts of up to 12 hours, and frequently push, pull, squat, bend and reach
nice: Industry certifications such as CompTIA A+, CompTIA Network+, Cisco/CCNA, Linux (Red Hat), Microsoft hardware installation or AWS
details.benefits: Starting pay $27.64 – $37.74 an hour (Atlanta, GA); final starting pay depends on experience, qualifications and location. Amazon lists comprehensive healthcare benefits from day one, a matching 401(k) program and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave; from day one employees also get EAP, mental health support and a medical advice line.
notes: Casual dress code (jeans, t-shirts, safety shoes, sometimes a safety vest)
Shifts can last up to 12 hours
Amazon offers workplace accommodations during the application and hiring process
